purpose: Public theory map used to seed LUNA formula evolution. No proprietary or undisclosed investment-firm formula is inferred.

public_theories.mechanism: Quality combines profitability, growth, safety and payout. LUNA currently uses price/risk/liquidity proxies when PIT fundamentals are unavailable.
Size, value, profitability and investment are added to the market factor. Fundamental inputs must be point-in-time.
Value and momentum have historically shown broad premia and negative correlation, motivating diversification between mechanisms.
Cross-sectional winners over roughly 3-12 month formation windows can continue to outperform; LUNA tests multiple horizons and cost/anchor stress.
Recent losers can exhibit reversal, motivating 1-4 month reversal seeds and multi-horizon blends.
Low-beta/low-risk exposure is tested as a separate defensive mechanism.
Gross profits-to-assets is a profitability signal and interacts with value.
Nine accounting signals combine profitability, leverage/liquidity and operating efficiency.
Post-earnings drift can be modeled from standardized earnings surprises and their history; requires announcement-aligned fundamental/estimate data.

research_policy.validation: OOS and final holdout frozen before promotion
research_policy.guard: 7% geometric monthly is a research hurdle, not a guarantee or promotion rule
